title: Tilde = r, macron = nasal
about: Where a scribe distinguishes a tilde (r) from a macron (n/m): mãzo, tẽra. Includes camãlingo (camarlingo).

rules.msg: marzo is written with a tilde (= r): mãzo
terra is written with a tilde (= r): tẽra / tẽre
camarlingo is abbreviated with a tilde (= r) over the a after m: camãlingo / camãlingho — no macron on the m
